== Course of events ==

Before the company's departure, the Winkies give parting gifts, marking the end of Dorothy's time among them following the earlier events that reunited the group. Dorothy also takes the Golden Cap from the Witch's cupboard before the party leaves. With these preparations complete, the group sets off for the Emerald City, intending to claim the promises Oz had made to them.

Dorothy is the central figure in this event, both in receiving the Winkies' gifts and in claiming the Golden Cap, while Emerald City is named as the destination toward which the company now travels. The journey sets in motion the expectation that Oz will fulfill what he had promised.
